classification: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL dataset (collection only). Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Not a new PPO variant.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-29: after 4v4 closes, 6v6 starts automatically with the same recipe; derived from SUITE_DISTILLATION_4V4_V2_SPEC.json.
parent: SUITE_DISTILLATION_2V2_SPEC.json / SUITE_DISTILLATION_4V4_V2_SPEC.json (the same recipe at N=2, 4)
SCHOOL_PC_6V6_LOCKED_PIPELINE.json (the sealed 6v6 Separated system whose pins are reused; SCHOOL_PC_6V6_*_SEAL.json)
RESEARCH_ROLE: Matched teacher-state set for the 6v6 sharing-family distillation arms (Share-Encoder, Fully Shared+z, Generalist (GENERALIST_DEFINITION_V1)), collected on the CERTIFIED poles.

ALLOCATOR_locked.source: SCHOOL_PC_6V6_LOCKED_PIPELINE.json (k=1, 5A/1D; same allocator as the 6v6 Separated arm)

ACTING_DEPLOYMENT_locked.why: States are visited under the live CLOSEST_DEFENDS allocator so the distilled arms train on the same role-structured state distribution the Separated arm sees.

KL_TEACHERS_locked.note: Acting policies generate the state distribution; KL teachers are the two single-strategy entity-repair specialists queried on every stored observation (same procedure as 2v2).

DATASET.roles_provenance: CLOSEST_DEFENDS roles attached at the stored pre-action tick (Pole A composite requires them for acting; stored for allocator audit; KL teachers ignore roles)
DATASET.entities_required: entity-repair teachers fail closed without teammates/enemies tensors at distillation time

SEEDS.chosen_by: seed_registry.next_free + allocate by the 6v6 chain at freeze
SEEDS.student_init_and_shuffle: allocated by the distillation spec, not here

POLES.source: the governing 6v6 certification (STRATEGIC_DEMAND_6v6_GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2_CERTIFICATION.json) through pole_attestation; the collector refuses if these overlays disagree with the certified poles, and asserts the live overlay each episode
POLES.size_normalized_gate: live min_alive_for_defender must equal 6 (NOT a pole check)

COLLECTOR.records_in_manifest: git identity, spec sha256, run fingerprint, seed-registry blocks, pole identity, allocator, acting pins, KL teacher pins, dataset_tag, per-shard counts
COLLECTOR.crash_recovery: --resume reuses shards whose embedded fingerprint matches exactly
COLLECTOR.code_identity: executed-code identity with the 2v2 collection (COLLECTOR_EXECUTED_CODE_ATTESTATION.json), checked by the 6v6 cross-scale audit

SMOKE_before_collection: the same command with --smoke (disposable 999xxxxx seeds, _SMOKE paths) must complete first
SAME_RECIPE_AS_2V2: identical to SUITE_DISTILLATION_2V2_SPEC.json except N (6), k (1), seeds, checkpoint paths/hashes, the certified pole overlays and tensor shapes that follow from N; enforced by the 6v6 cross-scale dataset audit before any student is trained
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: reusing these seeds for any evaluation
collecting without CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=1) on Pole A or off the certified 6v6 poles
substituting non-pinned checkpoints (the 6v6 checkpoints are hardlinks of 6v6/models/; never written)
SEQUENCE: freeze (chain) -> smoke -> collect once -> SUITE_DISTILLATION_6V6_DATASET.json -> 6v6 cross-scale audit vs 2v2 -> distillation spec
